name: Green Halftone Retro
tagline: Bright retro STEM lesson deck with mint-green fields, black outline typography, halftone textures, comic illustrations, and classroom grids.

palette.description: Mint green cover, pale blue-green content panels, black grid rules, white outlined type, and darker green halftone fills.

typography.style: Tall condensed outlined display type, with Bungee reserved for the oversized cover wordmark and clean classroom body copy.

best_for: Middle-school science lessons, STEM workshops, experiment explainers, classroom agendas, quiz boards, and playful technical training.
avoid_for: Executive reviews, sober research reports, legal materials, or brand decks needing a restrained premium tone.

source_inspiration.name: SlidesCarnival Light Green and Neon Green Halftone Retro Physics
source_inspiration.notes: Source-inspired HTML/CSS template rebuilt from public visual reference only; not a pixel copy and does not reuse source assets.
